name: form-field
description: A label, its control and its helper text as one column. The class carries the gap and nothing else — everything visible composes from the class layer, and the markup is a plain <div class="form-field"> around a <label class="label">, an <input class="input control"> and a <span class="helper-text">. What earns it a file is not the column: it is the error context. FormField publishes an `error` flag that useFieldError() reads, so a control inside it goes invalid without the call site threading a prop through every layer, and a control used outside one still honours an explicit prop. That is React context, which is the one thing on the bar that neither CSS nor HTML can express — a <fieldset> groups, but nothing in HTML propagates validity downward to an arbitrary descendant. Exports FormField, useFormField and useFieldError. WEIGHT: no runtime dependency beyond React and cn.
